blocks.prompt: 5. Use synthetic division to find the quotient and the remainder when the polynomial \(x^{4} - 10x^{2} - 2x + 4\) is divided by \(x + 3\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh linear divisor \(x + 3\) se division hai, aur sawal khud synthetic division ka kehta hai, jo long division ka chhota aur tez tareeqa hai.
Find kya karna hai? Quotient aur remainder dono.
Plan: coefficients likhna (missing \(x^3\) ke liye 0), \(a = -3\) pehchanna, table banana, jawab parhna aur remainder theorem se check karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = x^{4} - 10x^{2} - 2x + 4\), divisor \(x + 3\).
Humein find karna hai: quotient aur remainder.
Tareeqa: \(x - a\) se synthetic division, jahan \(a = -3\), kyunke \(x + 3 = x - (-3)\). Synthetic division sirf tab chalti hai jab divisor \(x - a\) ki shakal ka (linear) ho, aur yahan aisa hi hai.

Coefficients likhein
\[1,\ 0,\ -10,\ -2,\ 4\]
\[a = -3\]
Kyun: Synthetic division mein sirf coefficients istemal hote hain, bari power se chhoti power ki tarteeb mein. Is polynomial mein \(x^{3}\) ki term nahi, is liye us ka coefficient 0 likhna lazmi hai.
Dhyan dein: 0 likhna bhool jayein to har number ghalat column mein chala jata hai aur poora jawab ghalat ho jata hai.

Table banayein
\[\begin{array}{r|rrrrr} -3 & 1 & 0 & -10 & -2 & 4 \\  &  & -3 & 9 & 3 & -3 \\ \hline & 1 & -3 & -1 & 1 & \boxed{1} \end{array}\]
\[1 \times (-3) = -3,\ 0 + (-3) = -3\]
\[-3 \times (-3) = 9,\ -10 + 9 = -1\]
\[-1 \times (-3) = 3,\ -2 + 3 = 1\]
\[1 \times (-3) = -3,\ 4 + (-3) = 1\]
Kyun: Synthetic division ka tareeqa: upar wali line mein coefficients (missing power ke liye 0) aur baayen taraf \(a\). Pehla coefficient seedha neeche utarta hai; phir har neeche wale number ko \(a\) se multiply kar ke agle column mein likhte hain aur us column ko jama karte hain (diagonal: multiply, vertical: add). Yahan har dafa \(-3\) se multiply karna hai, is liye signs ka khaas khayal: negative × negative = positive, jaise \((-3)(-3) = 9\) aur \((-1)(-3) = 3\).

Quotient aur remainder parhein
\[\text{Quotient} = x^{3} - 3x^{2} - x + 1\]
\[\text{Remainder} = 1\]
Kyun: Box wala aakhri number remainder hai. Baqi numbers 1, -3, -1, 1 quotient ke coefficients hain. Dividend ki degree 4 thi, is liye quotient ki degree 3 hai: pehla number \(x^{3}\) ka, phir \(x^{2}\), phir \(x\), phir constant.

Tasdeeq: remainder theorem se
\[f(-3) = (-3)^{4} - 10(-3)^{2} - 2(-3) + 4\]
\[= 81 - 90 + 6 + 4\]
\[= 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Remainder theorem kehta hai ke \(x + 3\) se divide karne par remainder \(f(-3)\) hota hai. Hum ne alag tareeqe se \(f(-3)\) nikala aur wohi 1 aaya, is liye table bilkul sahi bana.
